category_title: Elementary student with ASD engaging in head-banging and arm-biting during transitions
minimal_context: Jake is finishing an independent puzzle activity and transitioning to a waiting period at his desk in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jake, independent work time is over. Please put your puzzle away and wait at your desk until we transition to the next activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the puzzle away and sits at his desk, left alone and unoccupied.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need to help the other students right now. Just sit there by yourself for a few minutes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sitting alone without any activities during the transition period, Jake begins to bite his arms.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jake, remember we are just waiting quietly right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to bite his arms and begins head-banging, engaging in self-injurious behavior that causes physical injury.)
